chunks: And the One who brought out the pasture.

key_terms.أَخْرَجَ: He brought out / caused to emerge
key_terms.الَّذِي: The One (relative pronoun referring to God)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'He brought out the pasture'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores Allah’s role as the ultimate sustainer (Ar-Razzaq) who prepares the grazing lands for His creation, linking natural provision to divine mercy. It serves as a theological affirmation of divine power over nature, reminding believers that sustenance is not merely a natural process but a deliberate act of God’s will. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on recognizing God’s presence in the everyday phenomena of the natural world.
